items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 2.8% in 1985 to 7.1% in 2025 across 359 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

0 of 470 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 8 for salt or chloride; 12 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 470 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 4 of 4 high-need ones have none.
